timeline_events.summary: Arnold Schwarzenegger remains on board for Terminator 3, but James Cameron will not direct the film due to irreconcilable differences with producers.

A Berlin appeals court upheld Arnold Schwarzenegger's 1999 legal victory over a German cardiologist who had predicted he would soon die from a heart condition, ordering the doctor to pay damages and issue a retraction.
Arnold Schwarzenegger announces he is considering quitting the film business and moving into politics, possibly running for governor of California.
Arnold Schwarzenegger launched a lawsuit against International Game Technology Inc for unauthorised use of his image and voice in Terminator games machines, seeking around $20m in damages.
Arnold Schwarzenegger's film Collateral Damage reached number one at the US box office with $15.1 million on its opening weekend.
A proposition supported by Arnold Schwarzenegger to provide educational support for children before and after the school day was approved in a California referendum.
Arnold Schwarzenegger was elected governor of California in a recall that removed Gray Davis from office.
Arnold Schwarzenegger said at a Cannes press conference that he plans to return as The Terminator in at least one more film and urged fans to see Terminator 3 to enable Terminator 4.
Arnold Schwarzenegger has not made a decision about whether to run in a possible recall election for California governor, with his adviser saying no decision had been made.
Arnold Schwarzenegger is likely to pull out of the race for California governor, according to an aide, though he has yet to make a formal announcement.

Arnold Schwarzenegger attended the London premiere of Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines, where he greeted fans and repeated his threat to return for a fourth film if this one does well at the box office.
Arnold Schwarzenegger announced that he would be running for the governorship of California.
Arnold Schwarzenegger announced on a television chat show that he would run for governor of California in the October 7 recall election.
Arnold Schwarzenegger announces his candidacy for California governor on Jay Leno's The Tonight Show.
Arnold Schwarzenegger hires billionaire investor Warren Buffett as senior economic adviser for his California governor campaign.

Arnold Schwarzenegger’s first television commercial of the California gubernatorial election campaign presents him as “the people’s governor” and avoids policy details, as he leads the polls ahead of the October 7 recall vote.
Arnold Schwarzenegger, trailing the leading Democrat by 13 points in the California governor recall race, faces discreet Republican efforts to give him a clear run as the Republican candidate.
Arnold Schwarzenegger came under fire for refusing to debate with other candidates for governor of California on television.
Arnold Schwarzenegger was hit with an egg on his neck during a campaign rally in Long Beach, California.
Arnold Schwarzenegger participated in a Californian recall election debate in Sacramento, where he had a heated exchange with independent candidate Arianna Huffington.
Arnold Schwarzenegger campaigns as a Republican frontrunner in the California gubernatorial recall election, with the vote scheduled for 2003-10-07.
Opinion polls show Arnold Schwarzenegger leading the field of candidates to replace California Governor Gray Davis ahead of the October 7 recall vote.

Arnold Schwarzenegger admitted he "behaved badly" and apologized after allegations that he sexually harassed multiple women over three decades, while campaigning in the California governor recall election.
Arnold Schwarzenegger denies reports that he expressed admiration for Hitler, calling the Nazi leader a "disgusting villain" and saying he does not recall making the remarks.
California voters go to the polls in the recall election, with Arnold Schwarzenegger leading despite allegations of groping 15 women.
Arnold Schwarzenegger is elected governor of California.
Accusations of sexual adventurism against Arnold Schwarzenegger in the California governorship race are noted, with the election day referenced as today.
Arnold Schwarzenegger is elected governor of California, ousting Democratic incumbent Gray Davis in a recall election.
Arnold Schwarzenegger was elected Governor of California, winning the gubernatorial election despite late allegations of groping published by the Los Angeles Times.
Arnold Schwarzenegger, as governor of California, called Hermann Maier after Maier's super-G victory at Kitzbuhel.
California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger declared a fiscal crisis and invoked emergency powers to implement $150 million in unilateral spending cuts.
Arnold Schwarzenegger and his family received gifts from celebrities after his election as California's governor in October.

California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger says he is not opposed to same-sex marriages and would find it "fine" if California law permitted them, contradicting his earlier denunciation of San Francisco's mayor for issuing same-sex marriage licences.
California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger wins two ballot measures on budgetary reform, authorizing a $15bn bond issue and compelling the legislature to pass a balanced budget.
Director George Butler, who made Arnold Schwarzenegger a star with Pumping Iron, plans a documentary about John Kerry, comparing Kerry's willpower to Schwarzenegger's.
Maria Shriver, wife of Arnold Schwarzenegger, unveiled a California landmark-themed jewellery collection, with about 25% of proceeds going to the California State Protocol Fund.

Maria Shriver unveils a California-themed jewelry line, with proceeds going to a fund for hosting foreign dignitaries, and Arnold Schwarzenegger praises her at the opening of an exhibition in Sacramento.
A book review discusses Arnold Schwarzenegger's cultural influence and political rise following his election as California governor.
California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger has been unable to win approval for his $103bn state budget, as California enters its third week without a budget.
Arnold Schwarzenegger is set to deliver a keynote address at the Republican National Convention in New York, emphasizing his life story as an embodiment of American opportunity.
California voters approved 11 of 14 propositions backed by Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger, including rejecting Proposition 66 to reform the state's three-strikes law.
Arnold Schwarzenegger, Governor of California, met Japanese Prime Minister Junichiro Koizumi in Tokyo during a five-day trade mission to promote California.

The UK television premiere of Arnold Schwarzenegger's film Terminator 3: The Rise of the Machines drew 4.5 million viewers for Channel Five, making it one of the station's most-watched programmes ever.
Arnold Schwarzenegger and the entire leading cast of Terminator 3 have been written out of the planned fourth film in the science fiction series.
Warren Beatty delivers a caustic speech attacking California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger, prompting speculation about a possible gubernatorial run against him.
California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger was due to decide on clemency for Stanley "Tookie" Williams before Williams's scheduled execution by lethal injection.
Arnold Schwarzenegger was involved in a motorcycle accident in Los Angeles while riding illegally without the proper motorcycle endorsement on his driving licence.
Producers planning the fourth Terminator film have given up on Arnold Schwarzenegger taking anything more than a cameo role, though they would still like him for a cameo.
Arnold Schwarzenegger participated in the only televised debate of the California gubernatorial election against Democrat challenger Phil Angelides.
Arnold Schwarzenegger participates in the only televised debate of the California gubernatorial election against Democrat challenger Phil Angelides.
Arnold Schwarzenegger won re-election as governor of California, defeating Democratic challenger Phil Angelides.
Arnold Schwarzenegger is noted to be turning 60 on Monday.
Arnold Schwarzenegger denies that cannabis is a drug, calling it "a leaf" in an interview with GQ, despite having previously admitted to smoking a joint in the 1977 documentary Pumping Iron.
Bodybuilder and actor Reg Park, who inspired Arnold Schwarzenegger, died aged 79.
California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger threatened to cut the pay of hundreds of thousands of public employees to the federal minimum wage in an attempt to balance the state budget.

California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed an executive order laying off more than 10,000 part-time and temporary state employees and reducing the pay of up to 200,000 state employees to the federal minimum wage in an attempt to address the state's $15bn budget deficit.
Arnold Schwarzenegger said he was shown early footage from Terminator Salvation but remained unsure about the film, saying he did not have a feel for it and did not see enough.
Speculation circulates that Arnold Schwarzenegger may be offered the role of energy czar in Barack Obama's incoming administration.
California governor Arnold Schwarzenegger declared a fiscal emergency and called lawmakers into a special session to address the state's $11.2bn deficit.
Arnold Schwarzenegger faces a crucial vote on ballot propositions to address California's $21bn budget deficit, with polls suggesting voters will likely reject the rescue plan.

California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger faces a severe budget crisis, with a projected deficit of $21bn by summer and $40bn by next year, causing his popularity to plummet to 33% and raising doubts about his political future.
Comments from Tom Arnold suggest a new film featuring Arnold Schwarzenegger is being planned, prompting speculation about a possible return to acting.
Eunice Kennedy Shriver, mother-in-law of Arnold Schwarzenegger, dies at age 88.
Arnold Schwarzenegger took part in the 2010 Vancouver Winter Olympics torch relay, carrying the torch at Stanley Park on the final day's route.
Arnold Schwarzenegger opened his third and final climate summit, rallying regional and business leaders on climate change.
Arnold Schwarzenegger launched the R20 climate network, an alliance of regional leaders pledged to work together to fight climate change.
Arnold Schwarzenegger said he is willing to consider returning to movies after leaving his post as governor of California.
Arnold Schwarzenegger leaves office as governor of California.
Arnold Schwarzenegger announced he is officially returning to acting, prompting speculation about a possible return in a fifth Terminator film.
Arnold Schwarzenegger is to appear as a superhero named the Governator in a new comic book and TV cartoon developed by Stan Lee, debuting on US television next year.
Arnold Schwarzenegger is reportedly considering The Last Stand as his return to live-action movies after finishing his term as governor of California.
Arnold Schwarzenegger signalled his intention to return to the role of the Terminator.
Arnold Schwarzenegger is set to return to the role of The Terminator in a new fifth film, with a rights package being shopped around Hollywood studios.
Arnold Schwarzenegger and Maria Shriver announced they had separated after 25 years of marriage, weeks after he ended his term as governor of California.
Arnold Schwarzenegger admitted he fathered a child more than 10 years ago with a member of his domestic staff, following his separation from wife Maria Shriver.
Arnold Schwarzenegger put his Hollywood comeback on hold to focus on personal matters after revealing he fathered a child with a member of his domestic staff more than 10 years ago.
Arnold Schwarzenegger was confirmed to return to the big screen in his first major film role since entering politics, starring in the action film The Last Stand.
Arnold Schwarzenegger and Maria Shriver file papers for divorce in a Los Angeles court after 25 years of marriage.
Arnold Schwarzenegger signs up to star in the western film The Last Stand as a small town sheriff, marking his return to Hollywood after his time as California governor.
A review of the film Conan the Barbarian notes that Arnold Schwarzenegger made his name in the 1982 original, which enabled his later political career.
A museum dedicated to the life and work of Arnold Schwarzenegger opened in his home village of Thal, Austria.
Arnold Schwarzenegger is confirmed to return to cinemas, with upcoming roles including a sequel to Twins titled Triplets, the action thriller The Last Stand, and The Expendables 2.

Arnold Schwarzenegger released his 650-page memoir Total Recall, which includes references to his sense of humor, bodybuilding career, real estate investments, affair with housekeeper Mildred, and relationship with Maria Shriver.
Arnold Schwarzenegger releases his 650-page autobiography, "Total Recall: My Unbelievably True Life Story."
Hollywood is planning a direct sequel to Conan the Barbarian that would restore Arnold Schwarzenegger to the role.
Arnold Schwarzenegger's comeback film The Last Stand is set for release next month.
Arnold Schwarzenegger confirmed plans for a new Conan movie in which he will star as an older version of the character.
Arnold Schwarzenegger returns to action films with the London premiere of The Last Stand, in which he plays a small-town sheriff.
Arnold Schwarzenegger is in talks to star in a remake of the 1984 cult film The Toxic Avenger, in an unspecified role that is not the title character.
Arnold Schwarzenegger confirms that sequels to The Terminator, Conan the Barbarian, and Twins remain on course to enter production.
Sylvester Stallone admits he fostered a "violent hatred" for Arnold Schwarzenegger during the pair's 1980s heyday, as their new film Escape Plan is released.
Global Witness reports that Arnold Schwarzenegger has financial ties through his part ownership of Dimensional Fund Advisers to logging companies accused of destructive and illegal logging.
Arnold Schwarzenegger confirmed he will appear as the T-800 in the upcoming film Terminator: Genesis, explaining that the Terminator's human flesh ages.
Arnold Schwarzenegger confirmed plans to star in a sixth Terminator movie, in which he would return as the T-800 cyborg.
Arnold Schwarzenegger said in an interview that he did not appear in Terminator: Salvation and that the film "sucked."
A review criticizes Arnold Schwarzenegger's dramatic performance in the film Maggie.
Arnold Schwarzenegger recorded voice commands as the Terminator for the Waze in-car navigation system.
Arnold Schwarzenegger returns to play his most iconic role in Terminator Genisys.
Arnold Schwarzenegger says he has not been asked to appear in Shane Black's planned Predator reboot and criticizes the franchise's sequels as unsatisfactory and driven by greed.
NBC announces that Arnold Schwarzenegger will replace Donald Trump as host of the reality show Celebrity Apprentice.

Paramount removed a planned Terminator sequel, which was to reunite Arnold Schwarzenegger with younger actors, from its 2017 release schedule after Terminator: Genisys underperformed at the US box office.
Paramount reportedly cancels the Terminator franchise, ending Arnold Schwarzenegger's involvement in future sequels.
Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as Roman, a construction worker whose wife and pregnant daughter are killed in a plane crash, in the film Aftermath.
Arnold Schwarzenegger approaches his 70th birthday, facing the ageing process as his dominance in film, politics, and public life ebbs.
